@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+---
+name: Dependabot Auto-Merge
+description: Automatically merges safe Dependabot dependency updates after tests pass
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    types: [opened, synchronize]
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  pull-requests: read
+  checks: read
+tools:
+  github:
+    toolsets: [default]
+timeout-minutes: 10
+strict: true
+---
+
+# Dependabot Auto-Merge
+
+This workflow automatically merges safe Dependabot dependency updates after tests pass.
+
+## Workflow
+
+1. **Detect Dependabot PRs**: Only run on pull requests created by Dependabot
+2. **Verify Safety**: Check that the PR contains only dependency updates
+3. **Wait for Tests**: Ensure all required checks pass
+4. **Auto-Merge**: Automatically merge safe dependency updates
+
+## Safe Update Criteria
+
+- PR author is `dependabot[bot]`
+- All CI checks pass
+- PR is not a major version bump (configurable)
+- No manual review required for patch/minor updates
+
+## Configuration
+
+The workflow uses safe-outputs to ensure:
+
+- `require-checks: true` - All required status checks must pass
+- `require-approval: false` - No manual approval needed for safe updates
+
+This reduces maintenance overhead while maintaining safety through automated testing.

feat(recipes): Enable Recipe Runner in nested Claude Code sessions (#2328)

* feat(recipes): Add NestedSessionAdapter for Recipe Runner inside Claude Code

Enables Recipe Runner to work when invoked inside an existing Claude Code session
by unsetting CLAUDECODE environment variable and using isolated temp directories.

Problem:
- Recipe Runner used CLISubprocessAdapter which spawned claude CLI
- Claude Code detects CLAUDECODE env var and blocks nested sessions
- This prevented Recipe Runner from working inside Claude Code
- ultrathink fell back to markdown workflows instead of code-enforced execution

Solution:
- Created NestedSessionAdapter that unsets CLAUDECODE before subprocess
- Uses isolated temp directories for each agent invocation
- Automatic cleanup after execution
- Auto-detection in get_adapter() when CLAUDECODE is set

Impact:
- Recipe Runner now works inside Claude Code sessions
- Agents can be invoked without "nested session" errors
- Full code-enforced workflow execution available
- Maintains resource isolation via temp directories

Testing:
- 5 outside-in tests created
- 4/5 tests pass (isolation test partial - requests approval as expected)
- Verified Step 2 now completes (was failing before)
- Tested multi-step workflow execution (30 steps)

Pattern Source:
Based on multitask skill pattern (.claude/skills/multitask/orchestrator.py:187)
which unsets CLAUDECODE for parallel workstream isolation.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(settings): Correct hook paths to include .amplihack directory

Fixed incorrect hook paths in SETTINGS_TEMPLATE and uvx_settings_template.json
that were missing the .amplihack directory component.

Problem:
- SETTINGS_TEMPLATE used: $HOME/.claude/tools/amplihack/hooks/
- Actual location is: $HOME/.amplihack/.claude/tools/amplihack/hooks/
- Missing .amplihack/ caused hooks to fail silently
- SessionStart, Stop, PostToolUse, PreCompact, SessionEnd hooks not executing

Root Cause:
- SETTINGS_TEMPLATE had hardcoded wrong paths (settings.py lines 40, 51, 63, 73)
- uvx_settings_template.json had same issue (lines 37, 48)
- ensure_settings_json() does update paths via update_hook_paths()
- But template used for initial creation causes wrong paths to persist

Fix:
- Updated SETTINGS_TEMPLATE in src/amplihack/settings.py (4 paths)
- Updated uvx_settings_template.json (synced via scripts/sync_hooks.py)
- All hook paths now correctly include .amplihack directory
- Prettier formatting applied

Impact:
- Hooks will now execute correctly on fresh installations
- SessionStart hook will run precommit_installer.py automatically
- All amplihack hooks will be callable
- Fixes recurring "hooks misconfigured" issue

Testing:
- Verified actual hook location: ~/.amplihack/.claude/tools/amplihack/hooks/ ✅
- Ran scripts/sync_hooks.py - templates synchronized ✅
- Pre-commit validation passes ✅

Discovery:
Found during outside-in testing of Recipe Runner nested session support.
